unsupported_statements: "Only a handful of other departments have ever requested this resource." The facts give no count of departments that requested the resource. They only give dept_resource_requests = 3, which is requests from this department for this resource.
"(higher means more likely denied)" The facts don't say how the risk score is oriented or that it predicts denial.
"the resource owner should review the request before approval" The facts name no resource owner and set out no such policy or process. This is a recommendation presented as a required step.
